method.comparison_unit_policy: The source-first reconstruction and its 39 comparison units were frozen before authoring the additive v0.2 card. Each unit receives exactly one unweighted verdict: agreement when HC-DU-183 explicitly supports or entails the published field, disagreement when the source-first object or type differs, and underdetermined when the source does not select or establish the field. Prior exposure to v0.1 is recorded and can bias agreement upward.

limitations: The reviewer had prior exposure to the v0.1 atlas, so this is source-first ordered but not blinded.
The comparison measures one analyst remap, not inter-rater reliability.
The collaboration papers were consumed through HC-DU-183's filed primary-source reconstruction rather than independently re-audited in this remap.
The exact finite fixture proves factorization logic, not the empirical frequency of ambiguous packets.

source_first_reconstruction.phenomenon_regime: Family-level dual-phase-xenon S1/S2 transduction and event association: accepted detector physics, triggerless retention, and accidental coincidences under parameterized above-threshold, calibration, drift-window, geometry, and event-class conditions. The packet composes evidence from multiple collaboration apparatuses and is not one numerically frozen experimental regime.
physical_initial_conditions: A dual-phase liquid-gas xenon target supports prompt scintillation, electron drift, extraction, and gas electroluminescence.
An admitted energy-deposition interaction occurs in the active liquid and can form excitation and ionization channels.
Clock, drift velocity, sensor response, active-volume geometry, and acquisition thresholds are calibrated for the declared class.
The event-building interval may contain multiple acquired S1 and S2 candidates.
Detector-specific field strengths, thermodynamic state, electron lifetime, diffusion, thresholds, rates, calibration epoch, and cuts remain unfrozen.
process: The interaction forms prompt S1 and ionization electrons.
Electrons drift, extract across the liquid-gas interface, and form delayed S2.
Sensors and triggerless DAQ retain separate above-threshold endpoint records.
Software later constructs target-blind compatibility edges and pairing estimates.
A correct pair conditionally supports drift depth; S2 pattern supports transverse position; S2/S1 and multiplicity support statistical classification.
record_topology: The underlying interaction occurrence is distinct from S1 and S2 traces.
S1 and S2 digitized peaks are distinct retained endpoint records.
The common-occurrence relation between one S1 and one S2 is a separate relation record and is absent from an untagged ambiguous raw packet.
An event-builder estimate is inferential and does not become physical provenance by algorithm alone.
A retained physical common tag or source-justified unique matchability can conditionally certify the relation and pairing-dependent depth.
One linear seven-stage ladder cannot preserve this branching endpoint-plus-relation topology without changing targets between stages.
observer_profiles: Analyst-selected DAQ archive profile: both unpartitioned endpoint streams and calibration context are visible; retention is possible but exact pairing is not.

Analyst-selected calibrated event-builder profile: both streams, geometry, calibration, compatibility rules, stochastic model, and optional side information are visible; pairing can be inferred and conditionally certified.
HC-DU-183 selects no observer, so neither profile is a source-owned canonical observer.
capability_tasks: Retain and query above-threshold S1 and S2 endpoint records.
Determine whether event membership and paired depth are constant over every physically admissible matching of the raw packet.
Conditionally reconstruct drift depth only after pairing is fixed.
Estimate transverse position from S2 pattern and perform risk-bounded statistical response classification.

Resources and risks include both streams, clock, drift and geometry calibration, thresholds, target-blind admissibility, optional physical tag, accidental coincidences, multiple matchings, calibration error, and overlapping response laws.
geometric_structures: Physical TPC active volume, drift direction, liquid-gas interface, and sensor-plane geometry.
Bipartite compatibility graph on acquired S1 and S2 candidates with target-blind admissibility edges.
Raw-packet fibres containing physical histories that share endpoint records but differ in common-occurrence relation and pairing-dependent targets.
The source establishes a graph and matching set, not a separately axiomatized matching complex.
source_first_reconstruction.issuance_assessment: UNDERDETERMINED_FROM_SOURCE: HC-DU-183 supplies no source-side issuance primitive or same-neighbor-data discriminator. Ordinary detector dynamics, acquisition, relation refinement, and delayed reconstruction are sufficient absorbers; no issuance classification is earned by the source remap.
source_first_reconstruction.finality_assessment: UNDERDETERMINED_AT_PUBLIC_AND_GLOBAL_SCOPE: a raw immutable packet does not settle event membership when multiple admissible matchings remain. Target-local settlement is conditional on a physical tag or unique matchability, but HC-DU-183 does not run the full local/public/global finality triple gate.
